notes.title: Hot fixes 3 - The Post NOA update
notes.content:
- Fixed incorrect spelling and grammar mistakes throughout.
- Unable for player to click the sparrow icon in certain scenes, that may result in Shouta appearing to randomly talk to himself.
- Fixed issues with certain scenes where Shouta's name tag was shown instead of Ayumi.
-  Watashi Suzume demo has been uploaded and extended from chapter 0 all the way to around the end of chapter 2.
- More bed bugs have been squashed.

This round of hotfixes brought to you by NOA, who finally got around to reviewing the game after being annoyed by us for almost a month.
Special thanks also to our dedicated group of WS game testers.
If any other bugs slipped through, don't hesitate to let us know via our official Discord, or Twitter (X?) 
Cheers, and I hope you all are enjoying our debut title!

notes.title: Watashi Suzume is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Watashi Suzume, as of today, is now officially available on Steam!

This is our first little attempt at a standalone game, and although it should mostly be in a finalized state there's no doubt some lingering issues have probably slipped through the cracks.
We've got our eyes and ears open on any and all feedback so we can work on creating our first patch and hammering out those remaining kinks.
Watashi Suzume retails for $9.99 USD, but for the first two weeks (I think it's 2 weeks) It will be available with a 10% discount.
All of this is completely new to us so if we happen to mess some things up here and there I apologize.
There's plans to fully release the OST later on, and to roll out a few free "DLC" updates at some point as well.

This was an incredible journey from start to finish, and the only thing on my mind right now is that I hope launch, and the first week goes fairly smooth. I know everyone is probably busy preparing for their long work weeks ahead, and I hate this day happened to land on a Monday of all days, but I made it a
personal mission of mine that I wanted to release WS on the "lucky" number 14th day.

Thanks to all who have supported us through the years, and I truly hope our first offering is something that you enjoy and entices you to stick around for whatever we come up with next.
Just go in expecting to find some jank. This is the first time we've released a game after all.

Much love as always, and I hope you enjoy this sparrow's story.

- Patt

notes.title: Watashi Suzume is now on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42918068/b78e9b777c05b177ecc7dac32711c42898d553bb.png[/img]

After a three year long dev cycle, our debut project, Watashi Suzume, is now available for wishlist on Steam!
So far, the response has been very supportive and encouraging. We love seeing so many of you excited to play our little studio's first offering.
We wanted to thank all of our early supporters so much for giving us a chance as we enter the final leg of this long, and sometimes difficult race. It certainly wasn't easy.

That being said, with Watashi Suzume on Steam we still have some ground to cover.
A big part of that will be doing everything we can to get the word out about our debut title.
For this, we ask our little community that has already done so much for us, if they could help in this endeavor. Any and all mentions, shout-outs, and word of mouth you all have provided and continue to provide help us out tremendously. With our release officially only two months away we are doing all that we can to put Watashi Suzume in front of as many people as possible.

So, beyond release, what's in store for us and WS?

WS will continue to be our primary focus throughout much of the new year.
We'd love to try our hand at adding extra content throughout the year to encourage fans to keep coming back again, and again, but there are no set in stone plans.
Above everything, we are hoping for a successful first launch.
I cannot tell you how anxious everyone is feeling right now.

I want to thank our small group of friends, and fans who have followed us since our old modding days.
We never would have made it here if it wasn't for your constant support.
I think I speak for everyone else from ShC when I say I hope your support continues and our community grows so that we are able to create more stories for you all to experience and enjoy.
My heart goes out to all of you.

May your roads always rise to meet you
- Patt
